doc.brief: Asynchronous API to open a file with an application.
doc.md:
Asynchronous API to open a file with an application.

`GtkFileLauncher` collects the arguments that are needed to open the file.

Depending on system configuration, user preferences and available APIs, this
may or may not show an app chooser dialog or launch the default application
right away.

The operation is started with the [`FileLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:launch) function.

To launch uris that don't represent files, use [`UriLauncher`](xref:gtk:Gtk.UriLauncher).

get_always_ask.brief: Returns whether to ask the user which app to use.
get_always_ask.md: Returns whether to ask the user which app to use.

get_file.brief: Gets the file that will be opened.
get_file.md: Gets the file that will be opened.

get_writable.brief: Returns whether to make the file writable for the handler.
get_writable.md: Returns whether to make the file writable for the handler.

launch.brief: Launches an application to open the file.
launch.md:
Launches an application to open the file.

This may present an app chooser dialog to the user.

launch_finish.brief: Finishes the [`FileLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:launch) call and returns the result.
launch_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileLauncher.launch()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:launch) call and
returns the result.

open_containing_folder.brief: Launches a file manager to show the file in its parent directory.
open_containing_folder.md:
Launches a file manager to show the file in its parent directory.

This is only supported for native files. It will fail if `file`
is e.g. a http:// uri.

open_containing_folder_finish.brief: Finishes the [`FileLauncher.open_containing_folder()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:open_containing_folder) call and returns the result.
open_containing_folder_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileLauncher.open_containing_folder()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileLauncher#method:open_containing_folder)
call and returns the result.

set_always_ask.brief: Sets whether to always ask the user which app to use.
set_always_ask.md:
Sets whether to always ask the user which app to use.

If false, the file might be opened with a default app
or the previous choice.

set_file.brief: Sets the file that will be opened.
set_file.md: Sets the file that will be opened.

set_writable.brief: Sets whether to make the file writable for the handler.
set_writable.md: Sets whether to make the file writable for the handler.

always-ask.brief: Whether to ask the user to choose an app for opening the file.
always-ask.md:
Whether to ask the user to choose an app for opening the file. If `FALSE`,
the file might be opened with a default app or the previous choice.

writable.brief: Whether to make the file writable for the handler.
writable.md: Whether to make the file writable for the handler.
